plain: Not able to be done in practice

webster.text: That cannot be done or performed; infeasible; not to be effected by human means, or by the means proposed.

more.text: Untractable; unmanageable; stubborn; as a fierce, impracticable nature.

example.quote: On this subject, it was the opinion of a great majority in Convention, that the thing was impracticable ; other embarrassments presented themselves.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, December 11, 1787 and the following sittings (Elliot prints no later date headings) (2d ed. 1836)
